text:
Priya Singh: Quick kickoff — Open Kit Hacklab launch. Plan: refapp repo release, 4 tutorials (getting started, customization, benchmarking, deploy), a data-driven benchmark blog, and a webinar. Need content owners + inbound lead routing. Thoughts?

Mateo Rivera: Love it. I'll own tutorials + demo repo. Can someone confirm benchmark dataset and metrics?

Samir Patel: We can use the online-retail subset + latency/cost/perplexity. Will run baseline on latest quantized models. ETA 5 days for runs.

Priya Singh: Perfect. Mateo, team can help craft prompts for benchmarks? We'll need deterministic eval prompts.

Mateo Rivera: Yes — will open an issues list in the refapp repo. Plan tutorials: 1) Quickstart (30m) 2) Customize prompts (45m) 3) Benchmarking (tutorial + hook) 4) Deploy with Dedicated/Private (demo infra).

Kate Liu: I'll produce 3 hero images and 6 social cards. Need copy by Tue EOD.

Alice Chen: For inbound routing, recommend: UTM tags + separate landing for enterprise leads -> zap to SFDC + HubSpot capture. Also, add a 'Request a demo' CTA for Dedicated/Private. I'll own routing + GA.

Priya Singh: Sounds good. Alice can you draft the UTM scheme? Also need webinar registration form fields.

Alice Chen: Draft here: `?utm_source=dev-content&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=hacklab_openkit&source=twitter` and event category 'Hacklab Open Kit Launch'. Webinar reg fields: name, company, role, use case, team size. OK?

Samir Patel: For reproducibility, I'll commit the run scripts. Also suggestion: add a flag to dump KV cache metrics.

Mateo Rivera: Great — for tutorials, let's include a small snippet showing client call:
```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key='REDACTED')
print(c.generate('Hello world'))
```

Priya Singh: Timeline proposal: Draft week (this week), assets next week, bench runs finish + blog draft week after. Webinar scheduled 2 weeks out Wed 10am PT. Can everyone confirm availability?

Kate Liu: Confirmed for assets next week.

Samir Patel: OK for runs, might need an extra day.

Alice Chen: I can prep routing + form by Fri.

Mateo Rivera: I'll open PRs for tutorials tomorrow. Will tag reviewers @Samir, @Kate.

Priya Singh: Awesome. I'll sync with CS for community channels and draft announcement copy. Anything else?

DesignBot: Reminder — asset checklist created: assets.openkit/ in Figma. Link: https://figma.com/... :white_check_mark:

Priya Singh: Thanks, linking this thread to project board. @Alice please also set lead scoring rule (engagement on webinar + form) before launch.

Alice Chen: Will do. Adding scoring: webinar_reg + demo_request -> MQL.
